summary: Wrote a 4-phase plan for the PATH_SCOPE false-clean defect. The single defect site is scan_tree's `git ls-files` enumeration, which returns zero rows for an on-disk-but-untracked file while the `-e` existence guard still passes, so the scan reports clean without a [SKIP]. The plan extracts a shared tracked-plus-untracked union enumeration library (mirroring script-inventory.sh's existing in-repo precedent) carrying three stderr-only diagnostics, wires both check-record-versioning.sh and the structurally identical check-task-references.sh to it, and adds acceptance fixtures to both lint suites. Exit codes and stdout formats stay byte-identical so verify-deploy gate 4 is unaffected.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan: shared git-corpus enumeration library plus unit suite, record-versioning lint wiring with the acceptance fixture, task-references lint mirror, then docs/redeploy/full gate sweep.
